reading.instructions: Native pinned JPEG image-first physical lines of Sunday epistle variants. cu provisional in Slavonic discourse; orv provisional for vernacular historical Ruthenian in later witnesses (Polish calques and syntax). Historical superscript placement, accent/breathing signs and exact glyph collation incomplete. Estimated line rectangles. Apparatus labels zxx/Zyyy. Combined apparatus physical rows preserved; logical entry and variant witness links on 122 and 124 deferred to common overlay (#366), not fabricated as region links. Separate same-context source reinspection of the ten original images before PR submission; first-pass drafts retained in earlier branch commits. All repeated printed variant markers retained, including two occurrences of ⁵) on IV/124; combined note-region links use the shared printed-note-entry annotation overlay rather than per-region guessed links.
